svg.aria-label: World map of the Navigate reference scenario: five fuel-supply regions shaded by their 2050 electricity cost, with Europe marked as the EU ETS and FuelEU jurisdiction
svg.text: gfs — a global well-to-wake intensity standard — covers both ports and every voyage.
Bunkering is aggregated into two ports: one EU, one rest-of-world.
Europe is the only region with a FAME pathway; in the Middle East the only bio routes are biogas.
Regions are model aggregates; disc positions are indicative, not plant sites.
